messages:
incident-bot: pager triggered — spike in 5xx (502/504) for model-runner-service in us-west-2. alert: ~95% 502s over 5m starting ~15:12 UTC.
pd-bot: Created INC-502345. pagers: @Bob (primary), @Alice (backup). runbook: https://pd.example/INC-502345
Bob: oncall here, seeing gateway 502/504s, upstream runner pods restarting rapidly. pulling logs.
Alice: i'm on it — loading traces and per-pod metrics.
Carla: grabbing runtime logs now. initial signs: repeated SIGSEGV from model-runner process. collecting stack and core.
Carla: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T15:12:31Z] model-runner[pid=2345]: signal 11 (SIGSEGV), addr=0x0
#0 0x7f8b3a2f in kv_cache_lookup(model_t*, char*) +0x1e
#1 0x7f8b3b4c in generate_tokens +0x7a
#2 0x55aa33 in model_thread_main
```
Megan: correlating with request metadata — failures skew to requests with very long context (>3k tokens). suspect KV cache growth + quantized attention path interaction.
Dave: CS: multiple enterprise tenants reporting failures/timeouts since 15:10. largest impact on customers using the long-context feature.
Lucy: drafting customer status now. need an ETA before notifying top-tier accounts.
Carla: immediate plan: 1) cordon/drain affected infer nodes 2) restart runner with reduced KV_CACHE_SIZE and smaller batch limits 3) route new traffic to fallback pool. starting node drains.
Bob: running: `kubectl cordon node-infer-07 && kubectl drain node-infer-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will rollout restarts across 5 suspect nodes.
Alice: setting temporary routing override to prefer rwd-small-v1 for new requests in us-west-2 to reduce long-runner pressure.
Megan: applying route: `redwoodctl route set-default --region us-west-2 --model rwd-small-v1 --weight 100` — noting potential quality regressions.
Carla: restarted 3 nodes with env overrides: KV_CACHE_SIZE=128, BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024, disabled large-batch auto-merge. one restart hit OOM; kernel log indicates: `Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model-runner)` — collecting vmstat and dmesg.
Carla: reducing reserved per-request KV allocation and disabling quantized-attn hot path as a short-term safety toggle. pushing runtime config hotfix.
Bob: rerouted traffic away from problematic hosts. 502 rate dropped from ~95% to ~20% in the last 2m. still seeing some tail 5xx on very long requests (likely in-flight requests on older pods).
Alice: suppressing alert noise and moving incident to mitigation state. @Lucy please send provisional update: we have routed traffic and applied mitigations; further investigation ongoing; ETA 30-45m for verification and staged rollforward.
Lucy: sending customer update now. using PD incident link and listing affected features.
Megan: root-cause hypothesis: use-after-free in KV cache when quantized attention path triggers alternate allocation layout under long-context workloads. will repro with stress harness and prepare ASAN-enabled build.
Carla: created debug bundle: `gcore 2345` -> /var/crash/model-runner-2345.core uploaded to s3://rbw-incidents/INC-502345/. also saved sanitized logs and perf traces.
Dave: recorded impacted customer list and opened CS escalation ticket; assigned to @Lucy and @Dave for communications.
Bob: handing active mitigation/monitoring to eng-runtime (Carla) for deep-dive. i'll stay on watch for 15m then step out. @Alice you're primary oncall going forward.
Alice: taking over oncall. will coordinate with Megan for patch validation and canary rollout. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INC-502345 state updated: mitigation in progress. next update scheduled in 30 minutes or on material change.
Carla: next technical steps: reproduce with long-prompt harness, build ASAN instrumented runner, draft minimal guard in kv_cache_lookup to null-check pointers and fail safe, stage canary rollouts to small subset, then expand if green.
Megan: prepping regression tests against canary and long-context workloads. target first patch candidate in ~2h.
Alice: tracking action items in incident doc: https://redwood/incoming/incidents/INC-502345 — will post updates.
Bob: adding note for postmortem: impact window, mitigation timeline, per-customer summary, and recommended permanent fixes (KV cache safety checks, quant-attn regression tests, OOM thresholds). handoff complete.
